note: The hardening ratchet (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-hardening-signal-design.md, H2). Every entry is a KNOWN, ACCEPTED debt: `refarm hardening --gate` goes red when a suite that is NOT listed here stops being hardened, and equally red when a listed one starts passing and the entry was not deleted. This file is edited BY HAND, always: no command writes it, because a baseline a machine can append to is a mute button that looks like coverage. Adding an entry is a diff someone reads; removing one is progress made permanent.

entries.note: runHostRendererConformance(kind, descriptorFactory) is driven by a HOST supplying its own renderer descriptors, and homestead exports no in-repo factory the collector can construct — so nothing here proves the host-renderer contract holds. Closing it means exporting a zero-argument reference descriptor factory from @refarm.dev/homestead (the shape every contract-v1 package already has as createInMemory*), after which the collector binds it by convention and this entry must be deleted.
